cards.name: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2
cards.buy_if: you want the fridge, the router and the phones covered for a night, from a box one adult can carry.
cards.skip_if: you'll want to add batteries later — this one doesn't expand.
cards.owners: Owners praise the recharge speed and Anker's support. Complaint: loud fans on fast charge.
cards.video_title: 6 best portable power stations of 2026 — including the C1000 Gen 2

cards.name: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus
cards.chip: Sub-10 ms UPS · 1,000 W solar · grows to 5 kWh
cards.buy_if: you want a home-office UPS today and room to add batteries and solar later.
cards.skip_if: you refuse to make an app account — firmware updates need one.
cards.owners: Owners praise the UPS and the app. Complaints: the account requirement, and it runs warm under heavy load.

cards.name: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2
cards.buy_if: you need the fridge and essentials for a day or two, or a weekend off-grid.
cards.skip_if: you'll want expansion batteries or big solar.
cards.owners: Owners love the simplicity and the weight. Complaint: fan noise on fast charge.
cards.video_title: Hurricane prep: testing a Jackery solar generator for power outages

cards.name: EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3
cards.buy_if: you want whole-home essentials, a well pump, or a transfer switch on the breaker panel.
cards.skip_if: you have no 240 V need — a 2 kWh unit plus a solar panel is smarter money.
cards.owners: Owners praise the quiet and the capability. Complaints: 114 lb, and the cost of the accessories.
cards.video_title: EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 review — full test results

cards.name: Anker SOLIX F3800 / F3800 Plus
cards.buy_if: an electric car, a dryer or a heat pump is on your outage list.
cards.skip_if: you don't need 240 V — the DELTA Pro 3 is the better buy at the same money.
cards.owners: Owners praise the power and Anker's support. Complaint: it drains itself when left switched on.
cards.video_title: Best home backup power stations of 2026

cards.name: Bluetti Elite 200 V2
cards.buy_if: you want the most specification per dollar and can lift 53 lb.
cards.skip_if: you want reassurance from customer support — Bluetti's is the weakest of the four.
cards.owners: Owners praise the cells and the price. Complaints: weight, and slow warranty replies.

cards.name: Jackery Explorer 1000 v2
cards.buy_if: you'll carry it — camping, car trips, a CPAP by the bed.
cards.skip_if: you need 2,000 W to run a microwave and a fridge together.
cards.owners: Owners praise the weight and the simplicity. Complaint: the fan on fast charge.

cards.name: Bluetti Elite 30 V2
cards.buy_if: you want a CPAP night or a weekend of devices, with real AC outlets.
cards.skip_if: you want to run a fridge for more than an evening.
cards.owners: Owners praise the size and the ports. Complaint: fan chatter in UPS mode.

cards.name: Anker SOLIX C300 DC
cards.buy_if: everything you own charges by USB-C.
cards.skip_if: anything of yours has a wall plug — get the plain C300 instead.
cards.owners: Owners love the size and the silence. Complaint: buyers who missed the 'DC' in the name.

cards.name: EcoFlow RIVER 3
cards.buy_if: you want a first power station for phones, a laptop and lights — and it can get rained on.
cards.skip_if: you want to run a fridge, or a CPAP with the humidifier on.
cards.owners: Owners like the price and the one-hour charge. Complaint: 'smaller than I expected'.
